component.name: Your Memi
component.summary: Remember the little things about the people you love

description.p: Your Memi keeps the specific, useful things you learn about the people in your life: the gift idea someone mentioned in passing, the plan you made over coffee, the allergy you don't want to forget.

ul.li: Every person gets their own categories, like Gift ideas, Plans and Notes
Categories can build up to a birthday, an anniversary or a trip, and show what's due as the day gets close
Still fresh brings back what you added recently and what's coming up
Mark ideas as a hit or a miss once they're done
Five colour schemes, each in light and dark

description.p: Everything stays on your computer. If you want your phone and computer to stay in step, sync keeps an end-to-end encrypted copy in your own Google Drive, which only your devices can read. There are no accounts, no ads and no tracking.

screenshot.caption: Your people, what's coming up, and one person's categories
Dark mode and the theme panel

description.p: The first release for Linux and Windows, rebuilt from the ground up.
